shared_elements: parallel linear bands or rows of repeated strokes
justification: The main shared content is only generic: both include schematic anthropomorphic imagery and simple linear/geometric marks such as bands, repeated strokes, and round or oval forms. A is dominated by a single frontal human-like body with anatomical features and curved bands on it, while B is a crowded panel of small linear signs, animals/boats or boat-like forms, and register-like rows with no comparable central figure or bodily arrangement.
